question: Which of the following is the oldest Joint Stock Bank of India established in 1865?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad Bank (now Indian Bank)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joint Stock Bank** is a bank having more than one shareholder.
 
• **Allahabad** is the oldest Joint stock bank established in the year **1865**.
 
• The first variety of joint-stock banks was the **Bank of Bombay**, established in **1720 in Bombay**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Types of banks in India**__
 
• **RBI**- Central Bank of India and **apex regulatory body**.
 
• **Schedule banks** - These are regulated by RBI, **Schedule Commercial banks, and Scheduled cooperative bank**
 
 
• Schedule Commercial bank
 
 
• Public sector banks, private sector banks, Regional Rural banks, and others.
 
 
 
• Schedule cooperative bank
 
 
• ​Urban cooperative bank and State cooperative bank.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Non-Schedule banks** - RBI does not regulate these.
